highlights: Green Lion Fit Air blends health monitoring with everyday style in a durable zinc alloy casing and soft nylon strap.

It keeps close tabs on heart rate, sleep patterns, stress levels, and daily activity with precise sensors and chipset. Count your steps accurately and access detailed HRV data to track your overall wellness.
The band uses magnetic charging and lasts up to 10 days on a single charge. It connects easily to iOS and Android devices.
Stay on top of calls and notifications, locate your band, all wrapped in a lightweight, adjustable fit for regular use.
